points.text: Democrats won control of Congress, with Keisha Lance Bottoms elected Georgia governor and Abdul El-Sayed and Roy Cooper winning Senate races in Michigan and North Carolina.
A cyberattack targeting refrigeration systems at several French blood bank sites was brought under control, and authorities said blood products were not compromised.
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa said a cyberattack led to fraudulent transactions; the bank said it was assessing the exact amount involved.
A mother and daughter were found dead near Bella Coola, British Columbia, after going missing on a hiking trail; authorities said an animal may have been involved.
Canva announced job cuts and workforce changes affecting about 22% of its staff, or more than 1,000 employees.
